verified: Deferred original file read and digest after dialog/session replacement do not POST or reopen.
A delayed genuine preview DTO cannot overwrite a replacement dialog.
Read revocation during original download prevents save and removes private body/title.
Original digest completion after close cannot trigger a download.
Original upload lost-ACK retries identical request body, nonce and original bytes; pending overview contains no payload.
A valid later accepted backend correction cannot acknowledge the earlier pending command.
Actual asynchronous cryptographic receipt validation after session replacement cannot consume the new pending request.
Different account fixture, changed profile revision and mismatched upload size are rejected.
limitations: Controlled Node tests execute the actual UI module and OfficeApi with accepted synthetic backend DTOs and a deterministic DOM host. They are not browser/HTTP execution claims.
The actual browser workflow and background visibility-handler evidence remain separately owned and recorded by finish_v6_clients.
No native-client review is claimed by this report.
